lead.subhead: About 50° at dawn, high near 56, only a light drizzle chance. Apple and Meta teamed up so Muse Spark Open runs on Mac Studios. OpenAI stepped back in the Apple trade-secrets fight. The Bulls host Minnesota tonight, and PFL crowns a women's flyweight champ at Wintrust Arena.

articles.deck: Box breathing, the 3-minute opener, then a Venus Friday for clean attraction and a full weekend slate.
articles.body: Volume XLIII is live from Carpentersville on a cool Friday (about 50° at dawn, high near 56, drizzle chance only about 11%). Saturday and Sunday look sunny and chilly. On the AI desk, Apple and Meta put Muse Spark Open — an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model — on pairs of M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX. OpenAI agreed not to use the Apple trade secrets at issue while the lawsuit continues, and will hand over forensic images from 14 ex-Apple hires. Anthropic gave six METR researchers employee-like access and dropped its veto over what they publish. xAI shipped Grok Voice 3.0, topping Artificial Analysis's speech-to-speech index. In the NBA, the Knicks edged the Raptors and Houston rolled Oklahoma City; tonight the Timberwolves visit the Bulls at 7 PM CT. Football: Caleb Williams feels ready after the hamstring, and Penix is expected to start Sunday when the Bears visit Atlanta. Combat is local: Liz Carmouche vs Jena Bishop for the first PFL women's flyweight title tonight at Wintrust on ESPN2; UFC Edmonton is Saturday. Friday belongs to Venus — attraction, craft, the things that pull people in. Solomon's line: better a little with quiet than a house full of strife. fall down 7 stand up 8.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Cool air, clear Friday, the day of Venus. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Breathe the way you want to attract today: steady, warm, nothing forced.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then attract the one win that matters.

mindset.body: Venus doesn't chase. She pulls. Liz Carmouche and Jena Bishop settle a rematch tonight for a brand-new belt — same opponents, higher stakes, no spare energy for theatrics. That's the Friday standard: stop scattering, start attracting. Win the first hour, make one thing beautiful enough that people lean in, and leave the weekend cleaner than you found it. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Friday: run this right after Morning Charge, breath first and then the body. Cool morning (low 50s), so a light warm-up jacket is fine before the RipStick finisher. Venus's day: crisp form, nothing sloppy.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Apple and Meta team up so Muse Spark Open runs on Mac Studios
items.body: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model (mixture-of-experts), and worked with Apple so it runs locally across two or four M5 Ultra Mac Studios using Apple's MLX framework. Mark Zuckerberg and Apple CEO John Ternus praised the work on X. Weights are on Hugging Face and major clouds under Meta's Muse Model License.

items.hed: OpenAI agrees not to use Apple trade secrets while the lawsuit continues
items.body: After Judge Edward Davila said he was highly likely to grant Apple's injunction, OpenAI voluntarily agreed not to use Apple's proprietary information for product development while the case plays out, and will hand over forensic images of drives from 14 employees who left Apple for OpenAI.

items.hed: Anthropic gives METR researchers employee-like access — and drops its publish veto
items.body: Six METR researchers get Anthropic laptops, office space, and internal tools on par with the company's own risk teams. METR can publish assessments of risks, incidents, and practices; Anthropic can require redactions only for narrow categories (customer data, privilege, architecture). xAI also shipped Grok Voice 3.0, #1 on Artificial Analysis's speech-to-speech index.

items.hed: Knicks edge the Raptors 122-120 at the Garden
items.body: New York took the rematch after Toronto's 50-point blowout earlier in the week. Scottie Barnes led the Raptors with 23; Jalen Brunson had 20 for the Knicks in a two-point preseason thriller.

items.hed: Rockets roll the Thunder 116-89 in Houston
items.body: Biggest win of Thursday night's slate. Jalen Williams scored 18 for Oklahoma City; Bogdan Bogdanović had 15 for Houston at Toyota Center.

items.hed: Tonight: Timberwolves at Bulls, plus a 12-game preseason slate
items.body: Minnesota visits Chicago at 7 PM CT (8 PM ET) at the United Center. Also on: Heat at Magic, Celtics at 76ers, Bucks at Pacers, Nuggets at Lakers (ESPN), and more.

items.hed: Caleb Williams feels ready to test the hamstring against Atlanta
items.body: The Bears quarterback went through his first full practice Thursday since the Week 2 injury against Minnesota and says he feels physically ready to start Sunday. Final go-ahead still rests with coaches and trainers; Tyson Bagent has been the fill-in.

items.hed: Penix expected to start for the Falcons barring a rib setback
items.body: Michael Penix Jr. returned to practice Wednesday and was a full participant again Thursday. Coach Kevin Stefanski said he expects Penix to start against Chicago if everything goes to plan after last week's exit against Baltimore.

items.hed: Bears at Falcons Sunday, noon CT on FOX — both QBs trending toward return
items.body: Chicago (3-2) visits Atlanta (2-3) at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, the most widely distributed FOX window. Both clubs lean on top-tier run games while their 2024 first-round quarterbacks work back from injury.

items.hed: Tonight in Chicago: Carmouche vs Bishop 2 for the first PFL women's flyweight title
items.body: Liz Carmouche and Jena Bishop rematch at Wintrust Arena for the inaugural belt. Main card airs on ESPN2 at 11 PM ET (10 PM CT); early card from 7 PM ET. Co-main: Timur Khizriev vs Gabriel Braga in a featherweight rematch.

items.hed: UFC Edmonton Saturday: Buckley vs Malott headlines Rogers Place
items.body: Joaquin Buckley meets Mike Malott in the welterweight main event; Erin Blanchfield vs Jasmine Jasudavicius is the co-main. Prelims 5 PM ET, main card 8 PM ET, entire card on Paramount+ in the U.S.

items.hed: Fundora defends the WBC super welterweight title against Hadribeaj
items.body: Sebastian Fundora (24-1-1, 16 KOs) meets unbeaten mandatory challenger Ermal Hadribeaj Saturday at The Chelsea inside The Cosmopolitan. Fundora is riding a four-fight streak and eyeing an undisputed shot.

Friday is Venus's day in the old planetary week ('vendredi' in French; Frigg's day in English, since the Romans matched Frigg with Venus). The Solomonic grimoires give the first hour after sunrise to the day's planet. Venus rules love, beauty, art, music and the bonds that draw people together. Magicians saved that hour for works of attraction and for finishing anything meant to be seen. Make one thing beautiful today.

Hermetic writers treat Venus as the planet of harmony — the force that joins opposites without crushing either side. The practical reading: stop forcing outcomes that only hold when you push. Build the version that holds when you walk away. If today's work only works under pressure, redesign it so it attracts on its own.

The Gospel of Thomas says: 'If you bring forth what is within you, what you bring forth will save you. If you do not bring forth what is within you, what you do not bring forth will destroy you.' The mystics read it as a rule for creation: the unfinished draft, the unsent offer, the unused skill — those are the real drains. Bring one of them into the light today.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of sacrifices with strife' (Proverbs 17:1). Peace with a little beats plenty with noise. On Venus's day, the counsel is simple: choose the clean win over the crowded one, and protect the quiet that lets good work land.
grimoire.practice: After four rounds of box breathing, name one noisy commitment you can shrink or delay this weekend. Write it in one line. Then start the 3-minute opener and protect that quiet for the rest of the morning.
